rule: Every createClient( under app/, lib/, sanity/ and components/ is either sanity/lib/client.ts (the choke point, wrapped by withFixture) or listed here with why it cannot run on a gated route. scripts/ are CLI tools that never run in the server and are out of scope. The network guard (block-sanity-net.cjs) is the backstop: any API request from the server process fails A15.

bypass.reason: token write client in a POST route; the gates only GET pages

bypass.client: createClient with a write token, useCdn false

studioOnly.reason: Studio validation callback (client.fetch from the Studio context), served at /studio, which no gate visits
